steps.name: types-tokenize-embeddings
steps.summary: types/{portfolio,notion}.ts + lib/{tokenize,embeddings}.ts 4개 utility (tokenize/estimateTokens/extractKeywords + cosineSimilarity/normalize/fixtureEmbedding/mergeScores) + 2 spec 파일 작성, 21개 테스트 통과

steps.name: chunking
steps.summary: lib/chunking.ts (chunkMarkdown/chunkPages/stableHash) — heading-based markdown 분할, 코드블록 분할 금지, FNV-1a stable id, mergeBelowTokens(prev≥threshold && cur<threshold), maxChunksPerPage 트림 + onWarn, tags via extractKeywords. specs/chunking.spec.ts 12 테스트 통과 (전체 33 통과).

steps.name: notion-service
steps.summary: services/notion.ts (server-only) + createNotionService(token, mock, fixtureDir, rateLimitBackoffMs) — queryDatabase/getPageRef/getPageContent/getPagesContent. MOCK 모드 (tests/fixtures/notion/db-projects.json + page-*.md), 실 API 모드 (raw fetch + @notionhq/client v5 + notion-to-md@^3, 한글/영문 속성 키 매핑, 429 backoff 4회, 401/403/404 → null skip). msw 핸들러 3종 (databases query/pages retrieve/blocks children). vitest stub `tests/stubs/server-only.ts` alias. 13 신규 테스트 + 기존 33 = 46개 통과.

steps.name: embeddings-service
steps.summary: services/openai-embeddings.ts (server-only) + createEmbeddingsService(apiKey, mock, baseURL, model, dimensions, maxBatchSize, retryBackoffMs) — embed/embedBatch. MOCK 모드는 lib/embeddings.fixtureEmbedding 재사용, 실 API 모드는 fetch로 POST /v1/embeddings (model=text-embedding-3-small, dimensions=1536). maxBatchSize=96 chunking + 입력 순서 보존. 4xx/5xx 즉시 throw, 429 backoff 4회(250→500→1000→2000ms). msw OpenAI handler 추가 (fixtureEmbedding 사용). 13 신규 테스트 + 기존 46 = 59개 통과.
